notes: Two changes, one experiment: title and meta description both moved. At 33 clicks/28d they cannot be separated, and both are the same surface (the SERP snippet).

The queries this page is shown for are dominated by qualifiers absent from the old title: メモアプリ 無料 (966 imp, 1 click, pos 8.4), メモアプリ 無料 シンプル (756 imp, 1 click, pos 9.3), メモ帳アプリ 広告なし 無料 (82 imp, 0 clicks). 「最強メモ環境」 answered none of them.

Brand-suffix hypothesis is SUGGESTIVE, NOT ESTABLISHED. Site-wide, titles carrying 「| Obsidian連携シンプルメモ」 average 1.72% CTR (67 pages, 7,889 imp) against 2.17% without (146 pages, 31,431 imp) — but position and page type are not controlled for, so this is a reason to test one page, not to strip suffixes site-wide.

The +36 clicks/month figure from analyze.mjs is likely OPTIMISTIC. Expected CTR came from a curve fitted on this site's mostly-Japanese SERPs; this page competes in English against large tech publishers, where a small site at position 8 plausibly earns less. Treat +10-20 as the realistic band.

The page IS still below its own segment, so the experiment stands — but it is a small bet, not the top opportunity it was recorded as. See growth/lib/gsc.mjs buildSegmentCurves.

experiments.hypothesis: Desktop visitors who click the App Store badge cannot install from where they are. A QR beside the closing CTA converts that dead end into an install.

before.note: Only /ai-tags/ (ja+en) carried a QR, out of 240 pages.

after.note: Desktop-only (min-width:900px), 132px, anchored to the last bottom-placement CTA. ct=<slug>-<lang>__qr.

baseline.source: GA4 event export 2026-07-13..2026-08-09 (28d), filtered device=desktop AND event=app_store_click

experiments.target_metric: App Store Connect campaign installs for ct=*__qr
notes: Ceiling is 21 clicks per 28 days. That is the entire desktop App Store click volume, and no more than that can be recovered. Do not size this as a growth lever.

NOT MEASURABLE IN GA4. A scan is not a click, so app_store_click will not rise — it may fall as desktop visitors scan instead of clicking. The only readout is App Store Connect campaign data for the __qr tokens, which is an owner action; growth/data/appstore/ is still empty.

Desktop converts worse than its traffic share (51% of search clicks, 35% of App Store clicks), which is expected: desktop visitors sensibly decline to click a badge they cannot install from. The waste is these 21 clicks, not half the audience.

The QR content was verified only by comparing the encoded string against each page existing bottom CTA href (identical but for __bottom to __qr). The rendered code itself has not been scanned. Scan one before marking this PR ready.
Excluded: relevance 0.3 pages, and pages with no bottom CTA (/ and /blog/obsidian-voice-input).

experiments.hypothesis: A contextual mid-article CTA reaches readers who never scroll to the closing CTA, raising session-to-App-Store rate above 3.8%.

before.note: Persuasive CTA was bottom-only; nav links aside, nothing before ~75% of the article.

after.note: 8 pages x 2 languages. Inline text link, not a badge — the conversion model allows MEDIUM pages one inline CTA with no stacked badges.

notes: Why now: 39 of the 53 pages carrying GSC traffic had a persuasive CTA only at the bottom, and those 39 take 486 of 694 search clicks (70%). GA4 says 10.4% of users reach 90% scroll depth. Most readers were never shown a reason to install.

COMPETING HYPOTHESIS, not yet ruled out: 56 users clicked App Store while only 139 reached 90% depth. 40% of deep scrollers converting is implausible, so a large share of the 60 clicks probably comes from the always-visible nav link or from the 14 pages that already had hero/mid CTAs. If nav is doing the work, this change adds little. The data-cta-placement dimension resolves this at the next snapshot — that is what it was built for.
Power: at a 3.8% baseline and 1,600 sessions/28d, only a near-doubling is detectable in one cycle. A 50% lift would need roughly 2.5 months. Read the placement breakdown, not just the aggregate rate.
No A/B split. data-cta-variant stays v1 everywhere; placement-level attribution replaces the need to split, and splitting at this traffic would halve an already underpowered sample.

Overlaps two running snippet experiments (/blog/free-memo-apps-ranking, /blog/offline-memo-apps). Not a violation of the one-variable rule: those measure GSC CTR (search to page), this measures App Store clicks per session (page to store). A body paragraph cannot move the first.

Excluded deliberately: /blog/line-keep-alternative and /glossary/aes-gcm/ (relevance 0.3 — the model says a strong CTA there spends trust without converting), and /blog/obsidian-voice-input (site strongest page at CTR 10.9%, not used as a test bed).

2026-08-11: 本実験の途中で、全ページ末尾に「次に読む」カード(P1-1)を挿入した。tag-cta-placements.js は placement を本文中の相対位置(frac)で決めるため、末尾にコンテンツが増えた結果 81件のCTAが bottom → mid に再分類された。**評価日 2026-09-13 に GA4 を placement 次元で見ると、実験と無関係に mid のクリックが増えて見える。**本実験の target_metric は app_store_click / session_start の集計比であり、ラベルの付け替えでは動かないため主判定は成立する。placement 別の内訳を見る場合のみ、08-11 以前と以後を分けて読むこと。
